quotes.text:
After calling around to several companies around south Florida, I finally got in touch with Juan. He made the process simple and easy all the way through from the second I got on the phone. I was able to set myself up on a payment plan with Afterpay financing and he was the only one who offered it!! Customer service A+

Jesus showed up prompt on time when he said he would and replaced the glass with lightning speed. I couldn’t believe how easy he made it look. I would definitely recommend Maximum Glass to anyone who needs windshield repair or replacement.
quotes.author: Chase Ross

quotes.text: I recently had the front glass window of my 2003 Grand Marquis repaired, and I couldn't be happier with the service I received. The technician came to my house and had everything fixed and installed in under an hour! The entire process was quick, efficient, and hassle-free. The technician was professional and courteous, ensuring that the job was done perfectly. Highly recommend this service for anyone needing quick and reliable auto glass repair!
quotes.author: Manolo Posada

quotes.text:
Jesus was incredible, very efficient, quick, professional, and he provided me great feedback and steps on how to proceed.
He removed the glass, and installed a new one while still talking me through what he was going to do, and what needed to be done. I would recommend 100%

I called this morning at 8:30am, and by 10:30 he was here, it was all done by noon! AMAZING!!
quotes.author: Angela Cicenia
